---
title: v3.0.1 — Isolated Skill Validation from Unmanaged Host Skills
---

## Overview

Agent Work Kit 3.0.1 fixes Skill CLI source validation when third-party Host Skills coexist in the same Skills directory. An unrelated external symlink, such as `find-skills`, no longer blocks the installed Work and Tooling Skills.

## Highlights

- Restrict the Skill CLI's installed source inventory to Agent Work Kit's managed `work`, `tooling` and `shared` roots, rather than treating every Host Skill directory as part of the installation.
- Ignore unrelated external Skill directories and links during Agent Work Kit source discovery and validation. Unmanaged Skills cannot be read through this Skill CLI.
- Preserve existing real-path and symlink/junction boundary enforcement for all managed Skill and Shared sources. Cross-installation links in managed roots remain invalid.
- Add regression coverage for coexistence with third-party Host Skills and rejection of managed-root link escapes. Clarify the boundary contract in the Skill architecture specification.

## Compatibility

This patch does not install, remove or authorize third-party Host Skills. Work records, public Work CLI contracts and the Rust workspace version are unchanged.
